verdict.rationale: Temporal ships its own Web UI that shows Workflow Execution state and metadata for debugging, and community users mention its visualization and an event log where errors appear. That confirms a first-party run-inspection dashboard, but the pack never documents its depth: a per-step timeline, per-step inputs, outputs, retries and errors, or search and filter. missing for 10: documented step-by-step timeline view, per-step input/output and retry/error display in the UI, dashboard search and filtering, independent hands-on corroboration of the debugging experience.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, every run has a step-by-step timeline — inputs, outputs, retries, and errors per step — in a dashboard my team can search and filter

citations.quote: The Temporal Web UI provides users with Workflow Execution state and metadata for debugging purposes. It ships with every Temporal CLI release
A lot of the good visualization Temporal offers is already possible with Netflix Conductor
workflows can hit a state that reads in-progress with errors buried in the event log
